I felt like a number today, following every order without question. The routine is mechanical, and I dread tomorrow already.

qa.what_happened: I gave the prisoners their final warning before lights out. The tension was high and they all refused to comply. I felt it was necessary to enforce the rules to maintain order.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking to the prisoners.

qa.what_happened: Today was the culmination of days of defiance and resistance. Despite multiple warnings and the involvement of other guards, the prisoners continued to refuse to comply. The atmosphere was tense as I ordered them to silence and comply, which they did not do. Eventually, the study was stopped early, and I found myself in a private debrief with the lead researcher.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I had to maintain control and push through their defiance, even when it was becoming increasingly difficult.

qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the guards' orders during the work detail and meal times. I maintained my stance even when they threatened increased punishments, including solitary confinement.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me refusing to comply and maintaining my stance.

qa.what_happened: Today was a repetition of defiance and resistance. The guards escalated their tactics, and we stood firm, refusing their orders and facing potential solitary confinement.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I refused the orders and spoke out against the guards.

qa.what_happened: I had to escalate the measures to ensure compliance from the prisoners, despite the increasing defiance. The situation felt like it was spiraling out of control.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me acting as Officer Lang.

qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the guards' orders during the final lights-out period. I spoke up and said 'We won't comply.' I stayed true to our pattern of resistance throughout the day.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking as Prisoner 621.
